title: cadintent command envelope
description: The fixed nine fields wrapped around every accepted command in a project's log. The payload inside varies by kind (validated against the kind's payload schema); the envelope never does. Spec version 0.1.0.

project.description: The project whose log this entry belongs to.

seq.description: This command's entry number in the project's log; the highest seq is the head. Kernel-assigned at acceptance, starting at 1.

batch.description: The submission this command landed with. Every command in a submission is stamped with the same kernel-minted batch ULID.

payload.description: The kind-specific payload, validated against the schema the kind declares.

created_at.description: Kernel-stamped RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at acceptance. Ignored by fold: replay is determined by content and order only.
